description: This file defines a Java class TimerWrapper that implements a proxy wrapper interface for timing method executions. It encapsulates an object delegate, measures execution time of method calls, and logs the timing information.

classes.name: TimerWrapper
classes.description: A final class implementing a proxy wrapper to measure and log method execution time.

methods.name: TimerWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TimerWrapper with the delegate object, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes the specified method on the delegate, measures execution time, and logs it.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs the method execution time with contextual information.
